entities.summary: Rani Rampal is an Indian field hockey coach and former player who played as a forward. At the age of 15, she was the youngest in the national squad of the 2010 World Cup. In her career, Rampal played 212 international matches and scored 134 goals. She also acted as a striker and doubled up as mid-fielder. In 2020, the Government of India honoured her with the Padma Shri.
